user.title: Connect to Pulsar
user.description: In Pulsar, open an appliance, go to **Linked Devices → Home Assistant → Link Account**, and enter the code shown there. Pulsar never connects to your Home Assistant; this integration connects out to Pulsar once a minute.

data_description.pairing_code: 8 characters, e.g. ABCD-EF23. Valid for 15 minutes.

data_description.url: Leave as is unless you run your own Pulsar server.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Pulsar
reauth_confirm.description: Pulsar no longer accepts this Home Assistant: it was disconnected in Pulsar or paired again. Get a new code in Pulsar and enter it here.

error.invalid_code: That code is not valid or has expired. Get a new one in Pulsar.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Pulsar. Check this Home Assistant's internet connection.
error.unknown: Unexpected error from Pulsar. Try again.

abort.already_configured: Pulsar is already set up in this Home Assistant.
